options.title: Ask the contracts
options.subtitle: Answers come only from the stored contracts, with sources.

parameters.jsCode:
const q = $('Read question').first().json;
return [{ json: { http_status: 400, source: q.source, answer: q.problem, sources: [] } }];

parameters.query: select jsonb_object_agg(key, value) as cfg from app_config;

-- "Search chunks" node of workflow C2. Parameter: the question embedding as text, e.g. '[0.12,-0.03,...]' (empty = no search).
-- The 6 chunks closest to the question by cosine distance (<=>), with the file and contract they belong to.
-- similarity = 1 - distance (1 means identical direction). Chunks without an embedding are ignored.
SELECT d.filename,
       c.chunk_index,
       split_part(split_part(c.content, E'\n', 1), 'Section: ', 2) AS section,
       c.content,
       ct.contract_ref,
       round((1 - (c.embedding <=> NULLIF($1, '')::vector))::numeric, 3) AS similarity
FROM contract_chunks c
JOIN contract_documents d ON d.id = c.document_id
LEFT JOIN contracts ct ON ct.source_document_id = d.id
WHERE NULLIF($1, '') IS NOT NULL
  AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY c.embedding <=> NULLIF($1, '')::vector
LIMIT 6;

-- "Load contracts" node of workflow C2. No parameters.
-- The structured contract rows, for exact dates and numbers (the text chunks can be vague about them).
-- Returns ONE row with a JSON array. The annual value is seats x price x 12.
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'contract_ref', c.contract_ref,
           'tool', t.name,
           'vendor', t.vendor,
           'seats', c.seats,
           'price_per_seat_per_month_usd', c.price_per_seat,
           'annual_value_usd', round(c.seats * c.price_per_seat * 12, 2),
           'billing_cycle', c.billing_cycle,
           'start_date', to_char(c.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
           'end_date', to_char(c.end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
           'notice_days', c.notice_days,
           'notice_deadline', to_char(c.end_date - c.notice_days, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
           'auto_renew', c.auto_renew,
           'owner', c.owner_email) ORDER BY c.contract_ref), '[]'::jsonb) AS contracts
FROM contracts c
JOIN tools t ON t.id = c.tool_id;
